notes: Primary full texts verified against supplied titles and DOI/version 1. No primary project-table URL supplied. Original n left null: Methods reports 27 recruited participants but does not explicitly establish per-test analytic n. Combined rows print p only; no effect size is invented. Outcome discrepancy: original Table 1 reports RT to arrows; replication Table 1 reports confirm RT. Replication values here are explicitly the latter, so target_match is false; do not treat these as a matched arrow-RT replication. The replication discussion states arrow RT effects replicated, but the Table 1 ANOVA cells do not report arrow RTs.
